key.name: window-width
key.summary: Window width

key.name: window-height
key.summary: Window height

key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Window maximized state

key.name: folder-pane-width
key.summary: Width of the folder sidebar

key.name: message-list-width
key.summary: Width of the message list pane

key.name: collapsed-folders
key.summary: Folders whose subfolders are hidden in the sidebar

key.name: collapsed-accounts
key.summary: Accounts whose folders are hidden in the sidebar

key.name: favourite-folders
key.summary: Folders pinned to the Favourites section of the sidebar

key.name: launch-at-login
key.summary: Start hidden in the background at login (mirrors the Background portal's autostart decision)

key.name: run-in-background
key.summary: Closing the main window keeps the application running

key.name: mark-read-delay
key.summary: Seconds a message must be shown before it is marked as read; 0 = immediately

key.name: confirm-delete
key.summary: Ask before moving a message to Trash

key.name: desktop-notifications
key.summary: Show a desktop notification for new mail

key.name: notification-sound
key.summary: Play the system new-mail sound

key.name: color-scheme
key.summary: Color scheme
key.description: Follow the system preference, or force a light or dark appearance.

key.name: message-list-density
key.summary: Message list density

key.name: show-preview-line
key.summary: Show a one-line preview under each message in the list

key.name: group-by-conversation
key.summary: Group the message list by conversation
key.description: Show one row per conversation in the selected folder; expanding it lists the messages the folder holds.

key.name: search-scope
key.summary: Where a search looks
key.description: The selected folder, every folder of its account, or every account; the last choice made in the search bar.

key.name: show-avatars
key.summary: Show sender avatars in the message list

key.name: monochrome-avatars
key.summary: Draw avatars in neutral grey instead of per-sender colours

key.name: monospace-plain-text
key.summary: Use a monospace font for plain-text message bodies

key.name: text-zoom
key.summary: Message body text zoom in percent

key.name: assistant-menu
key.summary: Show the Assistant menu that hands mail to Claude
key.description: The menu opens Claude Desktop or Claude Code on this computer with a prepared question about the selected mail.

key.name: assistant-target
key.summary: Where the Assistant menu opens Claude
key.description: Claude Desktop, Claude Code in a terminal, or the panel in the app; the last choice made in the Assistant menu or in the settings.

key.name: assistant-model
key.summary: The model the assistant panel uses
key.description: Sonnet, Haiku or Opus, passed to Claude Code.

key.name: assistant-claude-path
key.summary: Where Claude Code is
key.description: The claude executable the assistant panel runs; empty looks in the usual places.

key.name: assistant-consent
key.summary: The assistant panel may send mail to Claude
key.description: Set when the user allowed it the first time.

key.name: assistant-provider
key.summary: The provider of the assistant in the app
key.description: The in-app provider; external Claude hand-off is independent.

key.name: assistant-codex-path
key.summary: Where Codex is
key.description: The native Codex executable; empty looks in the usual places.

key.name: assistant-chatgpt-model
key.summary: The model the ChatGPT provider uses
key.description: Empty uses the provider's model default.

key.name: assistant-chatgpt-consent-version
key.summary: The accepted ChatGPT mail consent version
key.description: Zero means no permission to send mail to OpenAI.

key.name: board-triage-chatgpt-model
key.summary: The model ChatGPT uses for the board
key.description: Empty uses the provider's model default.

key.name: board-triage-chatgpt-consent-version
key.summary: The accepted OpenAI board consent version
key.description: Zero means no permission to send board mail to OpenAI.

key.name: board-default-style
key.summary: The style the Board opens in
key.description: Last Used (the style in board-last-style), List, Columns or Today; a changed choice applies the next time the Board is shown, unless a style was already picked in this run, which then stays until the app quits.

key.name: board-last-style
key.summary: The style the Board was shown in last
key.description: Written whenever the user changes the Board's style; read when board-default-style is Last Used.

key.name: board-start-mode
key.summary: What the main window shows at launch
key.description: Mail, the Board, or the mode shown last (board-last-mode). Always Mail while the Board is turned off.

key.name: board-last-mode
key.summary: The mode the main window showed last
key.description: "mail" or "board", written whenever the mode switches; read when board-start-mode is Last.

key.name: board-account-filter
key.summary: The account the Board is filtered to
key.description: The daemon's account id, written whenever the Board's account filter changes; empty means every account. Applied when the Board shows while that account still exists.

key.name: board-triage-consent
key.summary: The Board's triage may send mail to Claude
key.description: Set when the user allowed it the first time, apart from the assistant panel's consent.

key.name: board-triage-model
key.summary: The model the Board's triage uses
key.description: Sonnet, Haiku or Opus, passed to Claude Code; apart from the assistant panel's model.
